# Jaime Boylan

Jaime Boylan has participated in 1 election since 2002:

## Election History

### 2018 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Saviour No 2](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour-no-2) (2 seats), 16th May 2018.

**Jaime Boylan was not elected**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Louise Doublet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/louise-doublet)** |  | 874 | 71.9% |
| 2 | **[Kevin Lewis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis)** |  | 858 | 70.6% |
| 3 | Jaime Boylan | [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey) | 334 | 27.5% |

1,216 ballots (inc. 4 spoilt papers)

3,090 registered voters

= 39.4% turnout
